description: The apply window gen/pfb_quiet_hours (issue #4038, sub-slice 9c). A case's stored value is what config.xml holds (absent when the case has none); php is today's reader, pfb_quiet_hours_in_window(now, (string) PfbConfig::read('gen/pfb_quiet_hours')), at each of the instants (minutes after local midnight); applyWindow is what the settings adapter answers in ingest. schedule.InApplyWindow on applyWindow gives php at every instant. A refused row is a value Core refuses to read.

cases.description: Nothing stored: no window, an Update applies at once.
The General page's window switched off stores an empty string: no window.
What the General page stores: a window from 02:00 to 06:00, start inclusive, end exclusive.
A window across midnight, 23:00 to 01:00.
A window that ends at midnight, 22:00 to 00:00.
A hand-edited window with one-digit hours: today's reader takes it, the adapter answers it zero-padded.
A hand-edited window off the quarter hour: today's reader takes any minute up to 59.
One trailing newline: today's pattern has no D modifier, so it still reads as the window; the adapter drops it.
Start equal to end: today's reader never defers, so it is no window.
Hostile: not HH:MM-HH:MM (spaces around the dash): today's reader applies at once, so no window.
Hostile: not HH:MM-HH:MM at all.
Hostile: a three-digit hour.
Hostile: a one-digit minute.
Hostile: hour 24 is out of range: today's reader applies at once.
Hostile: minute 60 is out of range.
Hostile: a leading space.
Hostile: two trailing newlines no longer match today's pattern.
Hostile: a trailing carriage return.
Hostile: Arabic-Indic digits, which neither PHP's nor Go's \d takes.
Hostile: an array where the scalar is stored. Today's reader casts it to the string Array (with a warning) and applies at once; the adapter answers no window, without a warning.
Hostile: an empty array where the scalar is stored.

refused.description: Core holds a window zero-padded only: the adapter pads it.
Core holds no newline: the adapter drops it.
An array where the string belongs.
A number where the string belongs.
